text.title: FreshDrop team, weekly shopping of families, Moscow, August 2026
text.question: how families plan and change the weekly order, and what makes them cancel
text.sample: 14 families, 2 children each on average; 7 days; 2 dropouts
text.entry: event-based: an entry after each order; messenger photos of the fridge
text.a1: Tue 19:10: opened the app, searched «milk», gave up
text.a2: Thu 18:40: ordered by phone, asked for the 19:00 slot
text.a3: Sat 10:20: planned the week in the messenger
text.t1: «I always lose the slot, it is annoying»
text.t2: «The phone is easier, I trust the operator»
text.c1: the family plans on Sunday; the slot is the trigger
text.c2: phone ordering is the fallback for missed slots
text.c3: weekend planning is the habit to support
text.interview: what we clarified: the weekly plan is made on Sunday; cancellation is the fear of a missed slot
text.gaps: dropout after day 3 for 2 families; some entries are late
text.decision: build the reminder and the weekly plan; test with 50 families
